question: Why does the supreme power appear in the form of bindu while manifesting her own body?
premises: The supreme power manifests her own body.
This manifestation remains connected to the knowable aspect.
The knowable aspect introduces a kind of stain or limitation.
inference: Even while manifesting, the supreme power appears in the form of bindu because of the stain of the knowable aspect.
uncertainties: kalā may suggest a limited part or phase; the translation keeps it general as part.
plain_english: Here the supreme power, even while making her own body manifest, takes the form of bindu because of the stain associated with the knowable aspect.
